title: Drop retryAfter helper and fix stale scene docs
description:
Follow-up to closed JMAP-38uq.7 for spec 63e9d08.
Spec: draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md L2642: "When a rate limit is exceeded, the server SHOULD return a `SetError` of type `rateLimit` ({{RFC8620}} Section 5.3)." (the retryAfter property was removed). L304-307 heading: "The direction of the region's negative Z axis ... Default: `0` (negative Z points North)". L610 avatar id: "A ULID assigned at creation".
Code: crate-jmap-scene-types/src/set_error.rs:5-8; crate-jmap-scene-types/src/set_error.rs:12-22; crate-jmap-scene-types/src/lib.rs:38; crate-jmap-scene-types/src/lib.rs:76; crate-jmap-scene-types/src/region.rs:79; crate-jmap-scene-types/src/region.rs:295; crate-jmap-scene-types/src/avatar.rs:19-20; crate-jmap-scene-client/src/ws.rs:32
Now: scene-types exports RETRY_AFTER, retry_after and RetryAfterError for a property the draft no longer defines. The contentPolicy doc quotes the removed 'notify via SetError on a subsequent state-change' text. The GeoAnchor.heading doc says 'North to the region's positive Z axis'. The SceneAvatar.id doc says 'SHOULD use the userId as the id'.
Change: Remove (or deprecate) the retryAfter helpers, and fix the contentPolicy, heading (negative Z = North; +X East, +Z South) and avatar-id docs. Update the heading test's oracle comment.
close_reason: Batch 8b: committed and adversarially verified (or already fixed on main), see commit trailer
